description: This file manages Telegram target writeback logic, including normalization, rewriting, and persistence of Telegram chat IDs and message targets within a configuration management system. It interacts with configuration files and cron jobs, and provides functions for normalizing and updating Telegram-related targets.

methods.name: asObjectRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if it is an object, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramLookupTargetForMatch
methods.description: Normalizes a Telegram lookup target string for matching, converting to lowercase if it starts with '@'.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramTargetForMatch
methods.description: Parses and normalizes a Telegram target string for matching, including message thread ID.

methods.name: buildResolvedTelegramTarget
methods.description: Constructs a resolved Telegram target string based on raw input, parsed target, and resolved chat ID.

methods.name: resolveLegacyRewrite
methods.description: Resolves legacy Telegram target rewrite rules, returning match key and resolved target if applicable.

methods.name: rewriteTargetIfMatch
methods.description: Rewrites a raw value to the resolved target if it matches the specified match key.

methods.name: replaceTelegramDefaultToTargets
methods.description: Replaces default target fields in configuration and cron jobs with the resolved target if they match.

methods.name: maybePersistResolvedTelegramTarget
methods.description: Main exported function that persists the resolved Telegram target to configuration and cron jobs, with verbose logging and scope checks.
